trigger.what: Variance Bridge Engine closed the books on Aug 18 and measured CM at $10,640 against a $12,480 baseline.
The −$1,840 move cleared the ±$1,200 materiality band, so the bridge ran a full decomposition rather than logging the day quietly.
Anomaly Classifier tagged five of six drivers expected and one unexpected — an FBA fee change worth −$2,210 that nothing in the contract anticipated.

policy.definition: Gross revenue less discounts and cancellations, at the order date rather than the settlement date.
Landed cost at the moving average in force on the order date, including freight and duty.
Channel commission, referral and payment processing as settled, not as quoted.
Pick, pack, postage and packaging — the same CPO components the fulfilment flow reads.
Actual refunds processed in the period, not a provision. Restocking recovery is netted in.
Platform spend attributed to the day it ran, including any deal or promotion fees.

agents.name: Steward
agents.role: Owns the bridge, the contract and the residual target.

agents.name: Scout
agents.role: Watches for external causes — fee schedules, policy changes, competitor moves.

agents.name: Variance Bridge Engine
agents.role: Decomposes the daily move in the order above and computes the residual.

agents.name: Anomaly Classifier
agents.role: Tags each driver expected or unexpected, with the evidence it used.
